name: Spherical-coupler long-stroke knuckle (hub-2 lobe + O2.5 nose -> crank on dR -> spherical-4R coupler -> horn on link 1a)
lens: round11:coupler-longstroke (lens 1, the planner's C4; lobe-input control for dogring-draglink)
family: slaved-knuckle 3R (lead family with the free pin knee), long K dyad, lobe + spherical 4R drive
verdict: DEAD by the lead note's hard kill: no configuration of 1540 (256 coarse + one 4-start CMA batch of 1284, farm) has the drive in band >= 0.755 with <= 2 K-open drive contacts. Frozen pick (CMA-C best plain) 23.87 frozen exact Bench(110,360) (score 91.32) vs the lead's 18.49; drive in-band 0.70 (coupler 0.63) fails gate B; held out of the CMA best 29.73 (lead 23.45) with 11 K-open drive contacts. The far-side family is contact-free only off band (drive in-band 0.21-0.31, frozen 30.76-33.39).
limiter: Drive metal vs skin: every PA-legal stage-2 geometry swings the crank tip and coupler 25-37 deg sideways of link 1b over skin that rises up to ~33 mm above link 1b's level (skin-fit raise measured on the fit poses). At link 1b's level the spec side touches the deltoid (fit bench: 58 drive contacts, crank in 49, 34 of them with K CLOSED - the parked crank at internal rotation -75..-105; min 10 / median 26 K-open contacts); raised or on the far side the drive leaves the band (coupler 0.0-0.63). The CMA's best escape swings the arm back toward link 1b (t1 +25, cr_zr at its 8 mm clamp, horn +6.6), which shortens the PA-legal 4R table (dK_lim 60-65 vs 77+), so the long stroke is not used (dK taken 52) and reach stays at 266/360 (lead 261). Stage-1 wall: skirt 12.8 caps the crank at 32.6 deg (s_nose 4.0).
note: Convergence gate (score points): full sweep in run order gain 2nd half 2.15, last third 1.45, top-5 spread 0.39 (NOT passed); CMA runs A / B passed (0.27/0.06/0.06, 0.24/0.15/0.15), C (spec side) 2.93/0.00/0.77 and D (skin-fit) 0.99/0.53/0.26 not passed. Killed by the lead note's hard kill (one CMA batch, gate B < 0.755 / > 2 K-open contacts), not by convergence. Frozen exact Bench(110,360): Cp 23.87, C1 25.78 (held 29.73), C2 26.59, D1 (skin-fit) 27.39 (held 32.36), B1 30.76, A1 31.18, coarse best 33.39 (held 37.65). Strict fold reading passes on all (min th margin 5.0-6.9, none < 5). 3 active, 6 passive rotations, 0 passive translations; cx (catalogue) 27.75. The lobe band itself is not sampled (stated, ~8 points high on hub 2). Gate B read on the bench's own pooled in-band of the drive parts (crank, coupler, horn) over taken clip frames, not on parking_k.
